stages.name: 1-1 Bell at Dawn
stages.briefing: Drive the ashfang pack from Dawn Bell Court and open the village evacuation route.

stages.name: 1-2 Ash in the Orchard
stages.briefing: Clear the Ashwood Road before the displaced Ember beasts reach the refugee column.

stages.name: 1-3 Broken Menagerie
stages.briefing: Contain the maddened creatures that broke through Asterwatch's south menagerie.

stages.name: 1-4 Tracks of Silver
stages.briefing: Investigate the silver tracks left by an unknown scout in the orchard.

stages.name: 1-5 North Wall Refuge
stages.briefing: Hold the North Wall while Luna moves the wounded into the inner citadel.

stages.name: 1-6 Beastroad Ambush
stages.briefing: Break the monster ambush at Pilgrim's Turn without exposing the supply wagons.

stages.name: 1-7 Teeth at the Gate
stages.briefing: Reach Briar Gate before the largest displaced beast forces the ward line.

stages.name: 1-8 Thornmaw Matriarch
stages.briefing: Defeat the Thornmaw Matriarch and stop its stampede through the lower city.

stages.name: 1-9 The Second Shadow
stages.briefing: Pursue the geometric shadow that crossed the aqueduct after the first Breach opened.

stages.name: 1-10 Silent Metal
stages.briefing: Find the source of the silent metal figures advancing through the cloister.

stages.name: 1-11 Fallen Starcourt
stages.briefing: Retake Starcourt and prevent Chrome Scouts from completing their defender scan.

stages.name: 1-12 The First Captive
stages.briefing: Capture one disabled scout before its organic core can erase itself.

stages.name: 1-13 Heart of the Citadel
stages.briefing: Secure the Inner Bailey and stop the Chrome Host from mapping Asterwatch's wards.

stages.name: 1-14 Chrome in the Chapel
stages.briefing: Remove the cyborg relay planted inside the Sun Chapel's Radiant focus.

stages.name: 1-15 Vesper's Procession
stages.briefing: Break Exarch Vesper's escort before it reaches the Mirror Bastion.

stages.name: 1-16 Exarch Vesper
stages.briefing: Defeat Exarch Vesper before its adaptive lattice completes Astra's combat profile.

stages.name: 1-17 No Safe Banner
stages.briefing: Protect Banner Hall while the realm receives its first warning of Ironfall.

stages.name: 1-18 Wards Under Glass
stages.briefing: Restore the Glass Ward before the next Breach pulse strips its aether.

stages.name: 1-19 Last Evacuation
stages.briefing: Escort the final civilians across the terrace under concentrated drone fire.

stages.name: 1-20 The Name Nexaris
stages.briefing: Seize the Scrying Chamber and decode the enemy designation for Asterra.

stages.name: 1-21 Crownward Steps
stages.briefing: Climb Crownward Steps and cut power to the invasion anchor above the gate.

stages.name: 1-22 Sever the Beacon
stages.briefing: Destroy the beacon crown before it stabilizes a fortress-scale Breach.

stages.name: 1-23 Legate's Threshold
stages.briefing: Cross the antechamber and reject Legate Orrix's demand for surrender.

stages.name: 1-24 Legate Orrix-9
stages.briefing: Defeat Legate Orrix-9 and collapse the first Ironfall anchor.

stages.name: 2-1 Road of Refugees
stages.briefing: Secure the refugee ramp and begin the western evacuation across the Glassway.

stages.name: 2-2 Glassway Lower Span
stages.briefing: Clear the lower span while displaced monsters circle beneath the bridge.

stages.name: 2-3 Harpy Crosswind
stages.briefing: Break the harpy crosswind before it scatters the unarmored caravan.

stages.name: 2-4 The Absent Caravan
stages.briefing: Search the abandoned rest station for the caravan taken without a struggle.

stages.name: 2-5 Moonrail Junction
stages.briefing: Restore Moonrail Junction so the refugee trains can reach the upper span.

stages.name: 2-6 Signal in the Rain
stages.briefing: Trace the Nexari signal hidden inside the Glassway's storm conductors.

stages.name: 2-7 Winged Hunger
stages.briefing: Reach the harpy eyrie and locate the control signal driving its flock.

stages.name: 2-8 Galeclaw Matriarch
stages.briefing: Defeat the Galeclaw Matriarch and disable the splinters controlling it.

stages.name: 2-9 Beneath the Upper Span
stages.briefing: Advance along the underbridge while Mika searches for the missing prisoners.

stages.name: 2-10 Chrome Tollhouse
stages.briefing: Destroy the Chrome tollhouse processing captives for compatibility trials.

stages.name: 2-11 A Bridge That Hunts
stages.briefing: Stabilize the shifting span after a Nexari gravity test twists the bridge.

stages.name: 2-12 The Prison Convoy
stages.briefing: Free the prison convoy and remove its experimental aether siphons.

stages.name: 2-13 Celes Gate
stages.briefing: Hold Celes Gate while Sevrin adapts a captured siphon into a shield.

stages.name: 2-14 Railgun Weather
stages.briefing: Cross the Stormrail under fire from the Host's long-range batteries.

stages.name: 2-15 The Walking Bulwark
stages.briefing: Break the walking bulwark and identify the Lumerian crest inside it.

stages.name: 2-16 Bastion Kheiron
stages.briefing: Defeat Bastion Kheiron and prevent the converted knight from sealing the span.

stages.name: 2-17 Cut the Iron Vein
stages.briefing: Sever the iron power vein feeding Caelus's occupation grid.

stages.name: 2-18 Lanterns in the Fog
stages.briefing: Guide the refugees through the Lantern Gallery while the lights are suppressed.

stages.name: 2-19 No Road Back
stages.briefing: Retake the broken switchyard before the western route becomes impassable.

stages.name: 2-20 The Prefect's Offer

beats.text: Mara's cart loses a wheel before the first alarm. She is still arguing with a warden about her apples when the dawn bell stops halfway through a note.
That's the wrong bell. Where do we go for that one?
The sky above the orchard is folding. I can see the ward lines being pulled straight.
The north door is open. Walk, don't run. Leave the cart.
Take its boards for stretchers. Keep the horses with the children.
Silver fire falls upward. The ashfangs running toward the court are not hunting anyone. Something behind them is coming through.
